sources.access: Local raw JSON and logs: results/blocking, blocking-hint, blocking-investigation, kyo-blocking-research/controls and placement. Instrumented diagnostics explicitly separated from JMH.

claims.claim: Sync.defer is supported for blocking; flush optional
claims.evidence: BlockingContentionBench.scala and scheduler README flush section

claims.claim: Local submission queues explain initial concentration
claims.evidence: Scheduler.schedule, Worker enqueue/retire; nested vs external plain tasks, native Async.foreach, flush and fixed64 controls

claims.claim: Admission probes activate workers and affect observed delay
claims.confidence: high; activation mechanism inferred from source plus intervention, not traced per event

claims.claim: Automatic adaptation does not promptly supply 64 active lanes
claims.evidence: Worker time slice, BlockingMonitor, ThreadUserTime, regulator; actual monitor cadence and worker status; fixed16/64 and warmup30 controls
claims.confidence: high for this host and workload

claims.claim: CE immediately transfers queued work on IO.blocking
claims.evidence: IOFiber blocking branch and WorkerThread.prepareForBlocking; peak64 socket calls

claims.claim: Limited placement scan explains most remaining fixed64 gap
claims.evidence: scheduleStride default16, late first-call starts; full scan and spare capacity controls in three fresh JVMs each
claims.confidence: high for effect of intervention; individual placement race untraced

claims.claim: Virtual workers alone do not fix Kyo case
CE virtual request variant includes executor transition overhead
claims.evidence: BlockingBench ceVirtual definition and IOFiber blocking execution path
claims.confidence: high; whole-lane virtual variant not measured

claims.claim: No new tuned throughput ranking established
claims.evidence: Final controls are instrumented diagnostic medians, three JVMs; no JMH for fixed64 stride64

searches_and_stop: Read pinned Kyo scheduling, worker, monitor, CPU-time sampling, regulator, configuration, tests, benchmark and current-main differences.
Read exact CE release blocking dispatch and replacement-worker lifecycle; checked release source JARs.
Opened official Kyo documentation. Web exact-source URLs failed; verified cloned git sources instead.
Ran construction, submission, admission-cadence, worker-capacity, virtual-carrier, warmup, duration and placement controls.

Stopped after repeated placement controls closed most residual gap and alternative interpretations were bounded. Production and cross-platform generalization require separate benchmarks, not more source searches.
